notes: Inbound from pricing page — self-serve sign-up + trial credits used.
Primary contact: Alex Chen (Product Manager) — building tiny agent that triages customer tickets and opens support tickets automatically.
Key ask: short abstractive ticket summaries (1-3 sentences) + structured JSON output for ticket fields (priority, tags, suggested assignee).

Security: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) for admin console, audit logs mandatory. Data retention policy: default 30 days, negotiable. KMS integration requested for production later.
Quote from Alex: "We need structured JSON so our workflow engine can ingest right away — no post-parsing."
AE notes: good demo engagement, responded well to streaming + function-calling demo.
Decision criteria: latency & predictable cost per ticket, SSO, simple SDKs, example prompt templates for customer support flows.
They ran a small internal eval using Redwood free credits — saw promising latency for short summaries, want production SLA discussion if POC results match.
Prefer hosted API (self-serve) initially; may consider Dedicated next year if volume ramps and they need isolation.
